scripts.clean:deps: rm -rf node_modules frontend/node_modules backend/node_modules website/node_modules packages/*/node_modules bun.lockb frontend/bun.lock backend/bun.lock 2>/dev/null || true && echo '🧹 清理完成'
scripts.reinstall: bun run clean:deps && bun install && echo '✅ 依赖已清理并重新安装'
scripts.dev: bun run dev:fe & bun run dev:be & bun run dev:web & wait
scripts.build: cd packages/design-tokens && bun run typecheck && cd ../.. && bun run build:fe && bun run build:be && bun run build:web
scripts.watch: bun run build:fe --watch & bun run dev:be & bun run dev:web & wait
scripts.typecheck: cd packages/design-tokens && bun run typecheck && cd ../.. && cd packages/auth-core && bun run typecheck && cd ../.. && bun run typecheck:fe && bun run typecheck:be && bun run typecheck:web
scripts.typecheck:force: cd frontend && bun run typecheck:force && cd ../backend && bun run typecheck:force && cd ../website && bun run typecheck:force
scripts.lint: bun run format && bun run eslint && bun run stylelint
scripts.lint:check: bun run eslint:check && bun run stylelint:check
scripts.eslint: cd frontend && bun run eslint && cd ../backend && bun run eslint && cd ../website && bun run eslint
scripts.eslint:check: cd frontend && bun run eslint:check && cd ../backend && bun run eslint:check && cd ../website && bun run eslint:check
scripts.stylelint: cd frontend && bun run stylelint && cd ../website && bun run stylelint
scripts.stylelint:check: cd frontend && bun run stylelint:check && cd ../website && bun run stylelint:check
scripts.e2e:all: bun run e2e && bun run e2e:perf
scripts.audit:fe: bun run build:fe && bunx -y @lhci/cli autorun --config ./frontend/lighthouserc.json && bun ./scripts/lhci-summary.mjs && bun ./scripts/open-median-reports.mjs frontend
scripts.audit:web: cd website && bun run generate && bunx -y @lhci/cli autorun --config ./lighthouserc.json && bun ../scripts/lhci-summary-website.mjs && bun ../scripts/open-median-reports.mjs website
scripts.deploy:web: cd website && bun run build && echo 'Website build complete. Deploy dist/ directory to your hosting service.'
scripts.clean: cd frontend && bun run clean && cd ../backend && bun run clean && cd ../website && bun run clean
